title: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?
question: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers_yearmonth AS T1
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
ORDER BY T1.Consumption ASC
LIMIT 1
